picks.title: Audiotool 3.0 turns its multiplayer online DAW into an open platform for creator-built music tools
picks.excerpt: Audiotool 3.0 rebuilds its multiplayer browser DAW around NEXUS, a new open-source SDK that lets musicians and developers build their own instruments, plugins, visualisers and AI-connected music tools directly into the platform — with AI integrations via MCP and Context I/O so creators can wire their preferred LLMs into the DAW. Launch partners include Splice, Ujam, BandM8 and Fraunhofer.
picks.rationale: Fresh, high-actionability platform release: an open SDK + MCP/LLM hooks that lets producers wire AI tools straight into a browser DAW — changes how creators extend their workspace.

picks.title: Record industry proposes AI labeling system for streaming platforms
picks.excerpt: A coalition of eight music organizations (IFPI, RIAA, A2IM, WIN, IMPALA, the Recording Academy, SAG-AFTRA and the Human Artistry Campaign) proposes a voluntary streaming labeling standard with two tags — 'AI-generated' for fully AI tracks and 'AI-assisted' for human-led tracks that use AI — reshaping how AI-made music is disclosed to listeners.
picks.rationale: The single strongest of the RIAA/IFPI labeling cluster (Hypebot + Suno-response variants dropped): the source proposal itself sets a two-tag disclosure standard every AI-using artist will have to reckon with.

picks.title: Eldoraudio Guitar Audio to MIDI Converter
picks.excerpt: Eldoraudio's browser tool converts guitar recordings into editable MIDI using instrument-specific models, with the first 30 seconds free and a dedicated distorted-guitar model coming. It removes the manual transcription step between playing a riff and editing it as MIDI.
picks.rationale: Fresh, concrete workflow win: instrument-specific audio-to-MIDI that deletes the manual transcription step between playing a riff and editing it — distinct topic from the DAW and policy picks.
